# Termux-Vision (v1.4.4)
> Zero-Dependency On-Device Computer Vision & Multimodal VLM Inference Engine Utilizing Device Resources for Android Termux

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-vision
- Installation: `pip install termux-vision
# or: pip install https://github.com/uno-km/termux-vision/releases/download/v1.4.3/termux_vision-1.4.3-py3-none-any.whl
# or: npm install -g termux-vision
# or: bash <(curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uno-km/termux-vision/main/install.sh)`
- Architecture: Provides pure Python/JS 5-stage Canny Edge, Sobel 3x3, Gaussian Blur, 2D Integral Images, Haar Cascade Face Detection, and on-device SmolVLM/Qwen2-VL Multimodal Vision-Language inference with pure CPU ARM64 NEON optimization and optional modular Vulkan acceleration.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
import termux_vision as tv

# 1. Zero-Dependency Spatial Filtering (0.01s ultra-fast)
img = tv.io.load_image("photo.jpg")
edges = tv.cv.canny(tv.transforms.to_grayscale(img), 40, 120)
tv.io.save_image(edges, "edges.png")

# 2. On-Device VLM Multimodal Inference with Vulkan GPU Acceleration
with tv.vlm.load("smolvlm-500m", device="gpu") as engine:
    res = engine.describe("photo.jpg", prompt="Describe this scene in detail.", quality="optimal")
    print(f"Generated ({res.metrics.tokens_per_second:.1f} t/s): {res.text}")

```
